newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Glenayre Tech cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Glenayre Tech cut.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said it cut its near-term rating on Glenayre Technologies Inc to neutral from accumulate and cut its long-term rating to accumulate from buy.
-- The analyst was not immediately available for comment.

-- After Friday's market close, the company said it expected third quarter net income to be 40 to 50 percent below the same quarter last year because a lack of short-term shippable orders, sales mix and expenses would hurt earnings.
